Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "许可只明确覆盖接收方自己的员工或工作人员。", "name": "recipient_employees"}, {"meaning": "许可明确覆盖接收方自己的员工以及承包商。", "name": "recipient_employees_and_contractors"}, {"meaning": "许可明确覆盖接收方自己的员工以及顾问、代理人或专业顾问中的至少一类。", "name": "recipient_employees_and_professionals"}, {"meaning": "许可覆盖受接收方控制公司的员工，并另覆盖顾问或顾问类专业人员；不把这些员工改写为接收方自己的员工。", "name": "controlled_company_employees_and_professionals"}, {"meaning": "许可通过明确列表或当前可解析的 Representatives 定义覆盖员工并覆盖至少一种专业服务角色。", "name": "representatives_with_employees_and_professionals"}, {"meaning": "许可覆盖顾问、代理人、承包商或专业顾问，但不明确覆盖接收方自己的员工。", "name": "professionals_without_recipient_employees"}, {"meaning": "窗口形成实际许可，但其明确接收者组合不属于以上有限档案。", "name": "other_supported_recipient_profile"}, {"meaning": "所给许可窗口没有明确给出内部人员或专业服务接收者角色。", "name": "no_supported_recipient_profile"}], "examples": [{"choice": "controlled_company_employees_and_professionals", "quote": "2.1.3 only to disclose the Confidential Information to employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient, consultants and/or advisors to whom disclosure is necessary for the Permitted Purpose and then only on the understanding that such employees, consultants and/or advisors are expressly subject to the provisions of this Confidentiality Agreement.", "source": "ContractNLI:4607c94ccc67dee14eeed59b1e3fb9149bda4c8ddd1601bba8017bcbd5fca9d3"}, {"choice": "representatives_with_employees_and_professionals", "quote": "3. Neither party shall disclose the Confidential Information received from the other to any person or entity, except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents (collectively “Representatives”) involved in the performance of the Project, or to use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than fulfilling its obligations under the Project.", "source": "ContractNLI:6fce84641005b157aa8eda07d8372f5b6fd5f0f893665acfbfc3e8fdeda3597e"}], "name": "disclosure_recipient_profile_v1", "question": "把最后一个单元作为焦点，用前置单元解释同一披露许可，精确分类其接收者角色和所有权。接收方自己的员工、受控公司的员工、承包商、顾问、代理人和专业顾问不得相互替代；Representatives 只有在当前窗口给出实际成员或可解析定义时才使用相应档案。原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“2.1.3 only to disclose the Confidential Information to employees of companies directly or indirectly owned or controlled by the Recipient, consultants and/or advisors to whom disclosure is necessary for the Permitted Purpose and then only on the understanding that such employees, consultants and/or advisors are expressly subject to the provisions of this Confidentiality Agreement.” 原始 TRAIN（逐字）：“3. Neither party shall disclose the Confidential Information received from the other to any person or entity, except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents (collectively “Representatives”) involved in the performance of the Project, or to use the Confidential Information for any purpose other than fulfilling its obligations under the Project.”"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disclosure_roles_11", "operation": "disclosure_recipient_profile_v1", "unit_ids": [7, 8, 9, 10, 11], "current_units": [{"id": 7, "text": "(ii) is or becomes available to the receiving Party on a nonconfidential basis from a source which, to the best of its knowledge, is not known to be prohibited from disclosing such information to the receiving Party by a legal, contractual or fiduciary obligation to either Party;"}, {"id": 8, "text": "(iii) was in possession of the receiving Party prior to the disclosure of the information pursuant to this Agreement, provided that the source of such information was not known by the receiving Party, after due inquiry, to be subject to an obligation not to disclose such information; or"}, {"id": 9, "text": "(iv) is independently developed without reference to or use of the Information."}, {"id": 10, "text": "Accordingly, the Parties hereby agree that:"}, {"id": 11, "text": "1. The Parties and their Representatives (i) will keep the Information strictly confidential and will not (except as required by applicable law, regulation or legal process, and only after compliance with paragraph 2 below), without the prior written consent of the other party, disclose any Information in any manner whatsoever, and (ii) will not use any Information other than in connection with the Transaction; provided, however, that the Parties may reveal the Information to their Representatives (a) who need to know the Information for the purpose of evaluating the Transaction, (b) who are informed by the Parties of the confidential nature of the Information and are provided with a copy of this Agreement, (c) who agree not to disclose any of the Information to any other party and (d) who agree to act in accordance with the terms of this letter agreement to the same extent as if they were parties hereto."}], "focus_unit_id": 11}, {"id": "disclosure_roles_28", "operation": "disclosure_recipient_profile_v1", "unit_ids": [24, 25, 26, 27, 28], "current_units": [{"id": 24, "text": "Any oral Information will continue to be subject to the terms of this letter agreement."}, {"id": 25, "text": "Notwithstanding anything contained in the foregoing to the contrary, either Party may retain in the files of its legal counsel such documents and records as are required to be maintained in order to satisfy any law, rule, or regulation to which the Party is subject or for the purpose of determining its continuing obligations under this Agreement, including any rule of any national stock exchange."}, {"id": 26, "text": "Furthermore, if a legal proceeding has been instituted to seek disclosure of the Information, such material shall not be destroyed until the proceeding is settled or a final judgment with respect thereto has been rendered."}, {"id": 27, "text": "4. Neither Party hereto shall in any way or in any form disclose, publicize or advertise in any manner the discussions that give rise to this Agreement or the discussions or negotiations covered by this Agreement, including the fact that any such discussions have taken or are taking place, or any proposal relating thereto, including the terms and conditions thereof, without the prior written consent of the other Party."}, {"id": 28, "text": "Notwithstanding any term or implication herein to the contrary, either Party may disclose Information and any of the information described in the preceding paragraph to the extent such Party determines in good faith upon advice of counsel that such disclosure is required in connection with such Party’s disclosure responsibilities under the securities laws (including regulations, rules and interpretations promulgated or issued by a regulatory body), so long as such Party gives the other party such prior notice of such disclosure, and such opportunity to review, comment on, and lawfully limit the proposed disclosure, as is reasonably available under the circumstances."}], "focus_unit_id": 28}]}
